senses.definition: vb. cast a lot (cf. Ethiopic ወደደ immittere, etc. Di 935)—only
Pf. 3 mpl. יַדּוּ גוֹרָל עַל Na 3:10; Ob 11; יַדּוּ גוֹרָל אֶל־ Jo 4:3. (Poss. wrongly pointed pfs. of ידה Pi. q.v.)
